verdict.rationale: Baseten's first-party docs say cached input tokens are served from the KV cache at a discounted rate. The docs add that caching is automatic and needs no request flags, and that session-ID routing sends requests to the same replica so a shared prefix is more likely to stay cached. Together these cover the cost and latency benefit for repeated context. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the cost and latency savings, and evidence of prefix caching on dedicated (non-Model-API) deployments.
